newsitem.title: USA: More than 30 injured in Indiana plant explosion.
newsitem.headline: More than 30 injured in Indiana plant explosion.

text.p: More than 30 people were injured on Tuesday in an explosion at an aerosol packaging plant, police said.
The most seriously hurt were five firemen who suffered chemical burns fighting an ensuing fire, according to Bill Fletcher, a spokesman for the city police department.

He said the fire had been contained but about 2,500 people were evacuated earlier from areas north and east of the factory because of fumes from burning ethylene oxide which can cause respiratory problems if inhaled.
The explosion occurred at Accra Pac Inc., a company that packages aerosol products. About 600 people work at the plant but the blast occurred in a tank at an outbuilding.
The factory is located on the east side of Elkhart, a town of 80,000 in northeastern Indiana about 80 miles 128 km from Chicago.
